tokens.name: slate-900
tokens.usage: Main dashboard background, the app's ground. Overridden in the source theme; note it is DARKER than slate-950.

tokens.name: slate-950
tokens.usage: Sidebar, cards inside the dashboard (bg-slate-950 p-4 rounded-xl), and form inputs.

tokens.name: slate-800
tokens.usage: Headers, raised cards and secondary buttons; also THE hairline border colour (border-slate-800 is the most used class in the app).

tokens.name: slate-700
tokens.usage: Stronger borders, hover and selected rows, scrollbar thumbs.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text on filled brand buttons and the logo tile; headline numbers.

tokens.name: slate-100
tokens.usage: Primary text, input values. 17:1 on slate-900.

tokens.name: slate-200
tokens.usage: Body text in tables and cards.

tokens.name: slate-300
tokens.usage: Secondary body text, descriptions.

tokens.name: slate-400
tokens.usage: Muted text and the standard mono uppercase label. 7.2:1 on slate-900.

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Tertiary text, timestamps, sub-labels. FLAG: 3.7–4.0:1 on the dark surfaces, below 4.5:1 for the 9–12px text it is used at; prefer slate-400 for anything a person must read.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text. FLAG: ~2.4:1, fails as text; disabled states only.

tokens.name: indigo-300
tokens.usage: Brand text on brand-tinted fills; hover for indigo-400 links.

tokens.name: indigo-400
tokens.usage: Brand accent text: active nav, links, highlighted labels, figures. Named indigo in code but overridden to blue. 7.4:1 on slate-900.

tokens.name: indigo-500
tokens.usage: Logo tile, focus border on inputs (focus:border-indigo-500), active tab underline, filled-button hover. FLAG: white text on it is 3.7:1, below 4.5:1 for the 12px button label.

tokens.name: indigo-600
tokens.usage: Primary filled button (bg-indigo-600 text-white, 5.2:1).

tokens.name: indigo-700
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button.

tokens.name: indigo-800
tokens.usage: Deep brand, rarely used.

tokens.name: indigo-900
tokens.usage: Brand tint behind badges and selected items.

tokens.name: indigo-950
tokens.usage: Faint brand wash, e.g. the BackTest tag on the login screen.

tokens.name: emerald-400
tokens.usage: Profit, positive P&L, LIVE / success status text. Tailwind default.

tokens.name: emerald-500
tokens.usage: Profit fills and status dots; at /10 opacity a success badge ground.

tokens.name: rose-300
tokens.usage: Loss or error text on rose-tinted grounds.

tokens.name: rose-400
tokens.usage: Loss, negative P&L, error text. Tailwind default.

tokens.name: rose-500
tokens.usage: Danger fills, error dots; at /10 opacity an error badge ground.

tokens.name: rose-600
tokens.usage: Destructive filled button.

tokens.name: amber-400
tokens.usage: Warning and pending text.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Warning fills; at /10 opacity a warning badge ground.

tokens.name: purple-400
tokens.usage: Occasional categorical accent (strategy or signal type).

tokens.name: cyan-400
tokens.usage: Occasional categorical accent (secondary series in charts).

styles.usage: THE default UI size: inputs, buttons, table rows, card copy (454 uses).

styles.usage: Mono figures in dense tables: prices, quantities, timestamps.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The signature label: uppercase, tracking-wider, bold, slate-400 (or indigo-400 when active). Field labels, column headers, card eyebrows.

styles.name: label-micro
styles.usage: Status pills (LIVE), sub-captions under buttons. Smallest size; keep to short tags.
